meta.sourceOfTruth: Live MICHELIN Guide all-starred selection + individual detail pages + official venue sites
meta.starCounts: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star = 69 starred + 3 Guide-listed additions = 72 rows total.

items.name: Sushi Sho
items.clusterLabel: C1 · Midtown East / Bryant Park (41st St)
items.exceptions: No guests under age 13 (per official Tock page). Okonomi pieces ordered after omakase are billed additionally.
items.priceTwoAdults: $900 base / $990 prepaid w/ admin fee — Shorter Omakase at Hinoki Counter (2 × $450 base / $495 w/ fee)
items.priceNote: Published on official Tock page (exploretock.com/sushi-sho-nyc): Shorter Omakase $450/pp ($495/pp prepaid incl. administrative fee), excluding tax, beverage, and optional Okonomi.

items.name: Jungsik New York
items.exceptions: Entire table participation required for Signature Menu. Cannot accommodate soy or garlic allergies (per official Tock page). $200/person deposit.
items.priceNote: Published on jungsik.com/menu ('SIGNATURE MENU: 335') and confirmed on Jungsik's official Tock page. Optional pairings: Non-Alcoholic +$290/couple, Signature Wine +$450/couple.

items.name: Eleven Madison Park
items.exceptions: No dress code per MICHELIN. Reservations open on the 1st of each month for the following month via Resy; bar counter seats walk-in.
items.priceNote: Pre-tax & pre-beverage. Wine pairing starts at +$250/couple ($125/guest). Official FAQ lists Full Tasting at $385/guest and Bar Tasting at $255/guest (and 'begins at $225' in lounge FAQ).

items.name: Le Bernardin
items.exceptions: Business casual (no sneakers, shorts, t-shirts, sweatshirts). Lounge is walk-in (à la carte available). 48-hr cancellation fee $150/person.
items.priceNote: Published on official dinner-1.2.pdf ($218/pp) and lunch-2.191.pdf ($137/pp); excludes tax, tip, beverages, and optional caviar/truffle supplements. Chef's Tasting price not printed on those two PDFs.

items.name: Per Se
items.address: 10 Columbus Circle, 4th Fl, New York, NY 10019
items.exceptions: Bookings via Tock ($200/pp deposit for Main Dining Room; $150/pp deposit for Salon). Holiday/special seatings vary.
items.priceTwoAdults: $370 Salon 4-Course Tasting (2 × $185) · $950 Silver Experience for Two (Main Dining Room exact menu price unverified)
items.priceNote: Official Tock Salon page states $185/person ($370/couple). Official Thomas Keller Gift Experiences page lists 'Silver Experience for Two: $950.00'. Standard Main Dining Room Chef's Tasting per-person price was hidden behind deposit ($200/pp) on Tock — flagged.

items.name: Atera
items.exceptions: U-shaped open-kitchen counter seating; different start times Mon (19:00) and Sat (13:30 afternoon service). Booked via Tock.
items.priceTwoAdults: $596–$650 Seasonal Tasting Menu (2 × $298 on website schema; $325/pp on 2026 Tock search)
items.priceNote: ateranyc.com structured menu data lists $298/pp ($596/couple), Wine Pairing $198/pp, Temperance Pairing $138/pp; Tock search listing showed $325/pp ($650/couple). Both shown.

items.name: Saga
items.address: 70 Pine St., 63rd Floor, New York, NY 10005
items.daysOpen: Wednesday – Sunday per saga-nyc.com (MICHELIN lists daily — see exception)
items.exceptions: Irregularity flagged: saga-nyc.com explicitly states 'Closed: Monday & Tuesday', whereas MICHELIN's 2025 listing showed Mon–Sun 17:00–21:30. Follow venue's stricter Wed–Sun rule when planning. Reservations release 1st of prior month via Resy.
items.priceNote: Published directly on saga-nyc.com/menus ($215, $315, and $365 per guest; pre-tax/tip/drinks).

items.name: Gabriel Kreuther
items.exceptions: Directly faces Bryant Park. Holiday menus (e.g., Valentine's Day $375/pp) replace standard menus on select dates.

items.name: Masa
items.address: 10 Columbus Circle, Ste. 401, New York, NY 10019
items.exceptions: Moved from 3★ to 2★ in the 2025 MICHELIN selection. Full per-person deposit required via Tock.
items.priceTwoAdults: $990 Lunch Omakase (2 × $495) · $1,500 Dinner Table (2 × $750) · $1,900 Hinoki Counter (2 × $950)
items.priceNote: Published verbatim on Masa's official Tock pages (exploretock.com/masa), excluding tax and beverages. Chef's Reserve Counter is $2,400/couple (2 × $1,200).

items.name: Sushi Noz
items.exceptions: Chef Noz personally leads Mon–Fri 18:00 & 21:00 Hinoki counter seatings (with published exceptions on Tock); Ash Room counter serves the same menu.
items.priceTwoAdults: $990 Omakase at Hinoki or Ash Counter (2 × $495)
items.priceNote: Published on Sushi Noz's official Tock page ('We serve the same Omakase menu at both counters, priced at $495 per person').

items.name: The Modern
items.hours: Dining Room: Daily Lunch 12:00–14:30; Dinner Sun–Thu 17:00–21:00, Fri–Sat 17:00–21:30. Bar Room: Daily 11:30–21:00.
items.exceptions: Street-level entrance at 9 W 53rd St (no MoMA museum ticket needed). Closed Thanksgiving & Christmas.
items.priceNote: Published on themodernnyc.com/the-modern/ and /the-bar-room-at-the-modern/. Main Dining Room regular evening tasting price tab is client-rendered (flagged); lunch & Bar Room exact totals verified.
